enemy.name: OpFor: Quagmire
enemy.flavour_text: OpFor unit designed to emulate the liquid form of Originium. No one knows why it began to take such form, but it may be the precursor to another Originium disaster. Through simulation, we will find a way to destroy it, control it, or utilize it.

abilities.text: When blocked, plants itself on the blocker, causing them to take continuous Arts damage and increased Elemental Injury
When an Elemental Injury burst occurs on the parasitized target, inflicts a large amount of Elemental Injury of the same type on other allied units in the four adjacent tiles
